additional_info.subject: ID0385133-DC/Si-D/FR -[ItuS2K] Charger not functional correctly CRM:00796000894
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0385133 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s) :
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
Onsite Troubleshooting
YES
End Customer Communication
YES
Spare Part Ordering
Performance monitoring by RC
We found that there are missing converters in DC2 and a CAN communication loss for the power converter in the charger logs. We request that you please swap the converter with the neighbor and check if the problem persists. You need to identify which serial number is missing and swap it with a working converter. If the error occurs with the working converter, then the CAN cables may not be functioning properly.
DO NOT CHECK THE CONVERTER SCREEN WITH POWER ON.
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue, or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline on ISP.
Later assign the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2) Team
, using "
Assign
" function and then move the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
using "
Add to Queue
".
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Kaushik Kumar

change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
